findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice short questions for Chapter 2 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Chemistry Board shape (4 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 69 questions numbered 1-69; by section: 2.1 6, 2.2 3, 2.2.1 2, 2.3 1, 2.4.1 4, 2.3.2 6, 2.5 1, 2.5.1 2, 2.5.2 4, 2.5.3 3, u-spin-quantum-number-s 3, 2.6 1, 2.6.1 1, 2.6.2 1, 2.6.3 2, 2.7 2, 2.7.1 1, 2.7.2 3, 2.7.2~2 3, 2.7.4 1, 2.7.5 3, 2.8 2, 2.8.1 1, 2.8.2 2, 2.9.1 3, 2.9.2 2, 2.10 3, 2.11.1 2, 2.11.2 1.

Covers sections 2.1-2.11.2 in the book's order; comparison questions are answered as two-column tables; particle counts, e/m, 2n², 2(2ℓ+1), (n + ℓ) and ionization-energy ratios use new species or values and were recomputed in Python; none repeats the chapter exercise. The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
